# 1. Prepare master table 

## Clinical data

```{r}
metadata_general <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas_full/projects/RCC_DL/metadata_general.csv")
```

```{r}
metadata_other <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")

# Add fine-grained stages and grades
metadata_general$ISUP_simple <- metadata_other$ISUP[match(metadata_general$PID, metadata_other$PID)]
metadata_general$pT_simple <- metadata_other$pT_simple[match(metadata_general$PID, metadata_other$PID)]
```

### Preprocessing 

```{r}
metadata_selected <- metadata_general %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, age, gender,pT_simple, ISUP_simple, necrose) #Selecting simple staging here and not combined 

metadata_selected$necrose <- as.character(metadata_selected$necrose)

colnames(metadata_selected)[4:ncol(metadata_selected)] <- paste0("CLIN_",colnames(metadata_selected)[4:ncol(metadata_selected)])
metadata_selected <- as.data.frame(metadata_selected)
```

```{r}
# Make sure stage, grade and necrose are encoded as characters
metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_simple <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_simple))
metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_simple <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_simple))
metadata_selected$CLIN_necrose <- as.character(paste0("NE",metadata_selected$CLIN_necrose))

metadata_selected$CLIN_necrose[metadata_selected$CLIN_necrose == "NENA"] <- NA
metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_simple[metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_simple == "GNA"] <- NA
metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_simple[metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_simple == "TNA"] <- NA
```

### Encoding 

```{r}
# Perform preprocessing
metadata_selected[] <- lapply(names(metadata_selected), function(col_name) {
  if (col_name %in% c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(metadata_selected[[col_name]])  # Return the column as is
  } else {
    if (is.numeric(metadata_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.vector(scale(metadata_selected[[col_name]]))) # Scale numerical columns (Z-score)
    } 
    else if (is.character(metadata_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.factor(metadata_selected[[col_name]])) # Convert character columns to factors
    } else {
      return(metadata_selected[[col_name]])
    }
  }
})

str(metadata_selected)
```

### Correlation reduction 

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=16}
# 1. Check statistical association of numerical variables
cor_test <- metadata_selected %>% select(where(is.numeric), -status_OS,-OS_months)

if(dim(cor_test)[2] > 1) {
  cor_matrix <- cor(cor_test, method = "pearson")
  
  corrplot(
    cor_matrix,
    method = "shade",
    col = brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "RdBu"),
    type = "upper",
    order = "hclust",
    hclust.method = "ward.D2",
    addCoef.col = "black",
    addCoefasPercent = F,
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 40,
    diag = FALSE
  )
  
  # Identify pairs with cor > 0.95
  high_corr_pairs <-
    which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.95 &
            lower.tri(cor_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  high_corr_pairs_df <- data.frame(
    Var1 = rownames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[, 1]],
    Var2 = colnames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[, 2]],
    Correlation = cor_matrix[high_corr_pairs]
  )
}

# Nothing to remove here
```

```{r}
# 2. Check statistical association of categorical variables
chi_test <- colnames(metadata_selected %>% select(where(is.factor), -status_OS,-OS_months))

if(length(chi_test) > 1) {
  out_p <- list()
  
  for (i in chi_test) {
    for (y in chi_test) {
      if (i != y) {
        out <-
          metadata_selected %>% select(PID, any_of(i), any_of(y)) %>% unique %>% select(-PID) %>% group_by(all_of(i)) %>% table() %>%
          as.data.frame
        cur_test <-
          out %>% pivot_wider(
            names_from = i,
            id_cols = y,
            values_from = Freq
          ) %>% column_to_rownames(y)
        cur_test_out <- chisq.test(cur_test)
        out_p[paste0(i, "_", y)] <- cur_test_out$p.value
      }
    }
  }
  
  # FDR-correct p-values
  p_values <- unlist(out_p)
  adjusted_p_values <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")
  out_p_adjust <- as.list(adjusted_p_values)
  
  # Extract direct comparison p-values
  direct_comp <-
    matrix(
      NA,
      nrow = length(chi_test),
      ncol = length(chi_test),
      dimnames = list(chi_test, chi_test)
    )
  
  for (i in chi_test) {
    for (j in chi_test) {
      if (i == j) {
        direct_comp[i, j] <- 1
      } else {
        comp_name <- paste(i, j, sep = "_")
        rev_comp_name <- paste(j, i, sep = "_")
        if (comp_name %in% names(out_p_adjust)) {
          direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p_adjust[[comp_name]]
        } else if (rev_comp_name %in% names(out_p_adjust)) {
          direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p_adjust[[rev_comp_name]]
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Print the square matrix
  corrplot(
    -log10(direct_comp),
    is.corr = FALSE,
    diag = FALSE,
    tl.col = "black",
    type = "upper",
    col = COL1("Blues", 100),
    method = "shade",
    bg = "lightgrey",
    addCoef.col = "black"
  )
  
  
  # Identify pairs with
  high_corr_pairs <-
    which(abs(direct_comp) < 0.01 &
            lower.tri(direct_comp), arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  high_corr_pairs_df <- data.frame(
    Var1 = rownames(direct_comp)[high_corr_pairs[, 1]],
    Var2 = colnames(direct_comp)[high_corr_pairs[, 2]],
    Correlation = direct_comp[high_corr_pairs]
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Remove specific pair
removed_numeric <- NULL
removed_cat <- c("CLIN_ISUP_simple", "CLIN_necrose")

metadata_selected_fil <- metadata_selected %>% select(-all_of(removed_numeric), -all_of(removed_cat))
```

## IMC data 

### General - Across panel 

```{r}
general_key <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/general_key_features.csv")
```

```{r}
paste0("Number of EXP features before preprocessing: ", sum(str_count(colnames(general_key), "EXP_")))
paste0("Number of MC features before preprocessing: ", sum(str_count(colnames(general_key), "MC_")))
paste0("Number of D features before preprocessing: ", sum(str_count(colnames(general_key), "D_")))
paste0("Number of INT features before preprocessing: ", sum(str_count(colnames(general_key), "INT_")))
```

#### Preprocessing 

```{r}
# Preprocessing as suggested by Boeva (Cell Reports Methods)
# Step 1: Only keep columns with less than 20% of NA values 
## This often removes INT values
remove <- colnames(general_key)[colMeans(is.na(general_key)) > 0.3]
remove <- remove[!remove %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")]

general_selected <- general_key %>% select(-remove)

# Step 2: Missing numerical values can be imputed (Median across non-missing samples OR minimum for INT values)
summary(is.na(general_selected))

general_selected[] <- lapply(colnames(general_selected), function(colname) {
  if (colname %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(general_selected[[colname]])  
  } else {
    # If column has NA and is not excluded, replace NA with column minimum
    col <- general_selected[[colname]]
    if (any(is.na(col)) & str_detect(colname, "INT")) {
      col[is.na(col)] <- min(col, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    return(col)
  }
})

summary(is.na(general_selected))

# Add specific prefix
colnames(general_selected)[4:ncol(general_selected)] <- paste0("IMC_GEN_",colnames(general_selected)[4:ncol(general_selected)])
general_selected <- as.data.frame(general_selected)
```

#### Encoding 

```{r}
# Perform preprocessing
general_selected[] <- lapply(names(general_selected), function(col_name) {
  if (col_name %in% c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(general_selected[[col_name]])  # Return the column as is
  } else {
    if (is.numeric(general_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.vector(scale(general_selected[[col_name]]))) # Scale numerical columns (Z-score)
    } 
    else if (is.character(general_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.factor(general_selected[[col_name]])) # Convert character columns to factors
    } else {
      return(general_selected[[col_name]])
    }
  }
})

str(general_selected)
```

```{r}
remove <- remove[!remove %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")]

myeloid_selected <- myeloid_key %>% select(-remove)

# Step 2: Missing numerical values can be imputed (Median across non-missing samples OR minimum for INT values)
summary(is.na(myeloid_selected))

myeloid_selected[] <- lapply(colnames(myeloid_selected), function(colname) {
  if (colname %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(myeloid_selected[[colname]])  
  } else {
    # If column has NA and is not excluded, replace NA with column minimum
    col <- myeloid_selected[[colname]]
    if (any(is.na(col)) & str_detect(colname, "INT")) {
      col[is.na(col)] <- min(col, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    return(col)
  }
})

summary(is.na(myeloid_selected))

# Add specific prefix
colnames(myeloid_selected)[4:ncol(myeloid_selected)] <- paste0("IMC_MY_",colnames(myeloid_selected)[4:ncol(myeloid_selected)])
myeloid_selected <- as.data.frame(myeloid_selected)
```

#### Encoding 

```{r}
# Perform preprocessing
myeloid_selected[] <- lapply(names(myeloid_selected), function(col_name) {
  if (col_name %in% c("PID", "status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(myeloid_selected[[col_name]])  # Return the column as is
  } else {
    if (is.numeric(myeloid_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.vector(scale(myeloid_selected[[col_name]]))) # Scale numerical columns (Z-score)
    } 
    else if (is.character(myeloid_selected[[col_name]])) {
      return(as.factor(myeloid_selected[[col_name]])) # Convert character columns to factors
    } else {
      return(myeloid_selected[[col_name]])
    }
  }
})
```

#### Correlation reduction 

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=16}
# 1. Check statistical association of numerical variables
cor_test <- myeloid_selected %>% select(where(is.numeric), -status_OS,-OS_months)

if(dim(cor_test)[2] > 1) {
  cor_matrix <- cor(cor_test, method = "pearson")
  
  corrplot(
    cor_matrix,
    method = "shade",
    col = brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "RdBu"),
    type = "upper",
    order = "hclust",
    hclust.method = "ward.D2",
    addCoef.col = "black",
    addCoefasPercent = F,
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 40,
    diag = FALSE
  )
  
  # Identify pairs with cor > 0.9
  high_corr_pairs <-
    which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.9 &
            lower.tri(cor_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  high_corr_pairs_df <- data.frame(
    Var1 = rownames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[, 1]],
    Var2 = colnames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[, 2]],
    Correlation = cor_matrix[high_corr_pairs]
  )
}

high_corr_pairs_df
```

```{r}
# 2. Check statistical association of categorical variables
chi_test <- colnames(myeloid_selected %>% select(where(is.factor), -status_OS,-OS_months))

if(length(chi_test) > 1) {
  out_p <- list()
  
  for (i in chi_test) {
    for (y in chi_test) {
      if (i != y) {
        out <-
          myeloid_selected %>% select(PID, any_of(i), any_of(y)) %>% unique %>% select(-PID) %>% group_by(all_of(i)) %>% table() %>%
          as.data.frame
        cur_test <-
          out %>% pivot_wider(
            names_from = i,
            id_cols = y,
            values_from = Freq
          ) %>% column_to_rownames(y)
        cur_test_out <- chisq.test(cur_test)
        out_p[paste0(i, "_", y)] <- cur_test_out$p.value
      }
    }
  }
  
  # FDR-correct p-values
  p_values <- unlist(out_p)
  adjusted_p_values <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")
  out_p_adjust <- as.list(adjusted_p_values)
  
  # Extract direct comparison p-values
  direct_comp <-
    matrix(
      NA,
      nrow = length(chi_test),
      ncol = length(chi_test),
      dimnames = list(chi_test, chi_test)
    )
  
  for (i in chi_test) {
    for (j in chi_test) {
      if (i == j) {
        direct_comp[i, j] <- 1
      } else {
        comp_name <- paste(i, j, sep = "_")
        rev_comp_name <- paste(j, i, sep = "_")
        if (comp_name %in% names(out_p_adjust)) {
          direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p_adjust[[comp_name]]
        } else if (rev_comp_name %in% names(out_p_adjust)) {
          direct_comp[i, j] <- out_p_adjust[[rev_comp_name]]
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Print the square matrix
  corrplot(
    -log10(direct_comp),
    is.corr = FALSE,
    diag = FALSE,
    tl.col = "black",
    type = "upper",
    col = COL1("Blues", 100),
    method = "shade",
    bg = "lightgrey",
    addCoef.col = "black"
  )
  
  
  # Identify pairs with
  high_corr_pairs <-
    which(abs(direct_comp) < 0.01 &
            lower.tri(direct_comp), arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  high_corr_pairs_df <- data.frame(
    Var1 = rownames(direct_comp)[high_corr_pairs[, 1]],
    Var2 = colnames(direct_comp)[high_corr_pairs[, 2]],
    Correlation = direct_comp[high_corr_pairs]
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Preprocessing as suggested by Boeva (Cell Reports Methods)
# Step 1: Only keep columns with less than 30% of NA values 
## This mostly removes INT values
remove <- colnames(Tcell_key)[colMeans(is.na(Tcell_key)) > 0.3]
remove <- remove[!remove %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")]

Tcell_selected <- Tcell_key %>% select(-remove)

# Step 2: Missing numerical values can be imputed (Median across non-missing samples OR minimum for INT values)
summary(is.na(Tcell_selected))

Tcell_selected[] <- lapply(colnames(Tcell_selected), function(colname) {
  if (colname %in% c("status_OS", "OS_months")) {
    return(Tcell_selected[[colname]])  
  } else {
    # If column has NA and is not excluded, replace NA with column minimum
    col <- Tcell_selected[[colname]]
    if (any(is.na(col))){ #& str_detect(colname, "INT") - This call is removed for PIDs without tissue area info
      col[is.na(col)] <- min(col, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    return(col)
  }
})

summary(is.na(Tcell_selected))

# Add specific prefix
colnames(Tcell_selected)[4:ncol(Tcell_selected)] <- paste0("IMC_T_",colnames(Tcell_selected)[4:ncol(Tcell_selected)])
Tcell_selected <- as.data.frame(Tcell_selected)
```
